title.zh: 約教授另外的時間見面

subtitle: Office hours 跟其他課撞期，寫信另約時間
task: You cannot go to your professor's office hours because they are at the same time as another class. Write a short email to Professor Davis asking to meet at another time.
taskZh: 教授的 office hours 跟你另一堂課時間衝突，你無法參加。寫一封簡短的 email 給 Davis 教授，請求另外約時間見面。
focus: 稱呼與署名的正確格式
說明理由並提出自己可以的時段
使用客氣的請求句型（Would you …?）

en: My name is Jenny Huang, and I am a student in your Introduction to Psychology class. I would like to talk with you about my research project topic.
Unfortunately, your office hours on Thursday are at the same time as my biology lab. Would you be available to meet at another time? I am free on Monday and Wednesday afternoons after two o'clock.
Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.
zh: 我是黃珍妮，修您的心理學導論。我想和您討論我的研究報告題目。
可惜的是，您星期四的 office hours 和我的生物實驗課時間衝突。請問您方便另外約時間見面嗎？我星期一和星期三下午兩點以後都有空。
謝謝您撥冗。期待您的回覆。
